description: This file defines the PHP class PimReportSearchFilterParams, which extends a base FilterParams class and implements a ReportSearchFilterParams interface, encapsulating search filter parameters for reports in the OrangeHRM application, specifically including a report ID property.

classes.name: PimReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for defining search filter parameters for reports within the OrangeHRM PIM module, including report ID handling.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Retrieves the report ID associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setReportId
methods.description: Sets the report ID for the filter parameters.
